The generic fibre has classical 27 lines; the Grassmannian rank-four section with finite special fibre is a relative complete intersection, Cohen–Macaulay and finite flat of rank 27 over Z5. Quadratic coefficient-ring vectors satisfy all cubic coefficient equations, and a unit Plücker ratio p02/p01=t generates each exact ramified order. Six local rank≥2 branches plus fifteen rank≥1 sections saturate 27; hence the entire scheme decomposition follows. Mod5 each quadratic discriminant 5 yields dual numbers; product discriminant ideal 5^6. Independent conic-basepoint count corroborated six directions; finite F5 enumeration alone would not rule out nonrational geometric lines.
